security_observations.detail: Historical janus/db_guard allows full restore when JANUS_DB_GUARD_ALLOW_FULL_RESTORE is absent (default 1).
Second release was tiny explicit smoke candidate, not general autonomous new regression repair.
Experimental data contamination means positive model results cannot be generalized.
No agent or model installed or run as part of the audit. No NAS container, cron or privileged SSH modification.
No raw DB rows, wallet files, checkpoints, private keys or sensitive source paths copied to public repositories.

limitations: This is a bounded, nonexhaustive inventory. Scan limits and deliberate privacy exclusions prevent an all-files claim.
A source SHA-256 on NAS establishes local identity, not independent authorship or validity of its claims.
Normalizing the textual archive may change Git blob bytes; original SHA refers to NAS original.
No archive source was executed, no runtime checkpoint/rollback promoted, no proof of robust 24/7 NAS compute is claimed.
Remaining candidate paths are research leads, not validated missing GitHub capabilities until checked against current repo sources.
